text: A module M is called ___ when the functor − ⊗_R M preserves all exact sequences.
explanation: Tensoring is always right exact; flatness demands that it also preserve injections. Free ⇒ projective ⇒ flat, and the failure of flatness is measured by the derived functor Tor: ℚ is flat over ℤ while ℤ/nℤ is not.
